name: lasertag-vscode
description: CSS Modules done right: dead selectors, caught from your component's real render story.

lasertag.lsp.path.description: Optional path to a lasertag-lsp executable. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

lasertag.server.path.description: Optional path to a lasertag-lsp server module. Ignored when lasertag.lsp.path is set.

lasertag.typescript.sdk.path.description: Optional path to the TypeScript native executable used by the TypeScript 7 SDK. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root. Leave empty to use the bundled native executable.

lasertag.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VSCode and the lasertag language server.

lasertag.log.level.description: Controls lasertag language server operational logging. These logs are separate from protocol tracing.
